name: cheer
transformConvention: cframe = Motor6D.Transform as Roblox CFrame components [x,y,z,R00,R01,R02,R10,R11,R12,R20,R21,R22] (row-major rotation). Part1.CFrame = Part0.CFrame * C0 * Transform * C1:Inverse() (C0/C1 in characters/<Name>/rig.json). Easing on a pose applies from that keyframe to the next. A joint missing from a keyframe keeps interpolating between its neighbouring keyframes; weight 0 poses do not drive the joint.
